parts.label: (a)
parts.text: When $1.0\text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ $\text{Na}_2\text{S}_2\text{O}_3\text{(aq)}$ is added to a solution containing $\text{Ag}^+\text{(aq)}$ ions, a linear complex, **P**, is formed. $\text{S}_2\text{O}_3^{2-}$ ions are present in **P** as monodentate ligands.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Give the formula of **P**, including its charge.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: When $1.0\text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ $\text{NaCN}\text{(aq)}$ is added to a solution of **P**, a mixture which includes a second linear complex, **Q**, is formed. In this mixture the concentration of **Q** is much greater than the concentration of **P**.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Write an equation for the reaction that occurs when $\text{NaCN}\text{(aq)}$ is added to a solution of **P**.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Suggest a reason why the concentration of **Q** is much greater than the concentration of **P** in the mixture.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Name the type of reaction in which **P** forms **Q**.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Platinum forms a complex ion with the formula $[\text{Pt(CN)}_2\text{Cl}_2]^{2-}$. In this complex ion the carbon atom of each $\text{CN}^-$ ligand bonds to the platinum ion. This complex shows stereoisomerism.

parts.label: (c)(i)
(c)(iii)
parts.text: Name the type of stereoisomerism shown by $[\text{Pt(CN)}_2\text{Cl}_2]^{2-}$.
